notablePrerequisites:
Luxior attached to Gideon.
You control creatures that can tap to produce at least {2}{C}.
description:
Activate creatures by tapping them, adding at least {3}{C}.
Activate Gideon's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Gideon.
Activate Luxior's first equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Gideon.
Repeat.
